info.name: Chromatic Coordinates
info.description:
A coordinate experiment built from distance, angle, and time. 
Each pixel is centered around the screen, then measured by its distance and angle from the origin. Distance creates the rings, angle twists them into a spiral. Try changing r, a, and colors.

renderpass.name: Image

info.name: Distance Fields Basics
info.description:
A circle described entirely by distance. 

For every pixel, we calculate its distance from the circle's surface. Negative values are inside, zero is the edge, and positive values are outside. We can create a fill, outline, glow or animation mask!

renderpass.name: Image

info.name: Boolean Geometry
info.description: Distance fields become powerful when simple shapes can be combined mathematically. Take this eclipse for example, distance fields can be combined like shapes in a drawing program. min() creates a union, while max() can subtract one shape from another.

renderpass.name: Image

info.name: Tiled Space
info.description: fract() divides coordinate space into repeating local cells. We can then design one shape inside a single cell and receive an entire field of copies. This shader builds one rounded portal, cuts an opening in its center, and repeats the result.
